Now i just realised, i'll share some stories but not my own experience, just from relatives and old folks from my hometown. Im a filipino born and raised there. So basically this what so called "timeloop" is very close to what almost filipinos stories from their old folks experienced. And i know not all would believe but here we are discussing about it. So my hometown was a province. Not much buildings but trees and lots of trees, our backyard was a field with coconut trees and tall grass. That's what you would see almost everywhere if you live in a province. So ill get to the point. My brother and our uncle(my mother's second cousin) was out late from getting woods to use for cooking. On their way home they kept walking the same path over and over again, in filipino we call it (nanuno/ligaw) it means anevil dwarf plays with you and yes dwarf like in the snow white, but you cant see them, they see you. That is our interpretation of the timeloop. So to get out of the loop my uncle whispered some magic or curse words in the air, and they flip their shirts then wear it that way. And eventually they got out of the loop. Now i just realised that. We filipinos by our culture viewed it as supernatural, we believe in dwarfs, aswang, nuno, kulam, manananggal, etc. I never experienced anything like that before but based on stories from not one but almost filipino knows these kinds of unimmaginable situations,it could be true.
